command:paged.ai.ask: Registered inline in main.tsx's CanvasAppIntegration (opens the assistant panel with the payload as its draft, auto-run); main.tsx boots the app on import, so no unit test can import the registration; asserted in the browser tier.
command:paged.chrome.toggleAll: Registered inline in PagedShell over its own toggleAll closure (dock and tool-rail visibility state); there is no unit seam short of mounting PagedShell, so its behaviour is asserted in the browser tier (Tab, View menu).
command:paged.chrome.togglePanels: Registered inline in PagedShell over its own togglePanels closure (dock visibility, the tool rail kept); there is no unit seam short of mounting PagedShell, so its behaviour is asserted in the browser tier (Shift+Tab).
command:paged.sample.hello: the catalog's own demo command, registered to prove the worker-bundle contribution path works; it is not product surface and has no user-facing behaviour to assert.
